Corresponding source for the bundled ffmpeg binary was not found.
This file does not clear the sale gate. The gate still requires
THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES/ffmpeg-corresponding-source/LIBRARY_SOURCES_AND_BUILD_SCRIPTS.txt
to begin with the binary SHA256. That file is intentionally absent.
This note is not a statement that GPLv3 has been satisfied.

Binary
  name: ffmpeg-win-x86_64-v7.1.exe
  size: 87638016
  sha256: 2ce797a0f88d7f067180338fb227f7b1928ea727bd9a4d7a1d022f7c52af71a3
  same bytes: bin/ffmpeg.exe inside
    https://github.com/GyanD/codexffmpeg/releases/download/7.1/ffmpeg-7.1-essentials_build.zip
    published 2024-09-30, tag 7.1, zip size 92100272

What that release contains
  GitHub release assets, retrieved 2026-10-26: six binary archives only
    ffmpeg-7.1-essentials_build.7z
    ffmpeg-7.1-essentials_build.zip
    ffmpeg-7.1-full_build.7z
    ffmpeg-7.1-full_build.zip
    ffmpeg-7.1-full_build-shared.7z
    ffmpeg-7.1-full_build-shared.zip
  The essentials zip contains bin/ffmpeg.exe, bin/ffplay.exe, bin/ffprobe.exe,
  generated HTML documentation, libvpx ffpresets, LICENSE, and README.txt.
  It does not contain library source trees, patches, a configure script for
  the libraries, or a build log.
  The git tag 7.1 of GyanD/codexffmpeg contains only README.md.
  Its automatic GitHub zipball is that README, not the FFmpeg source.

What the README identifies
  License: GPL v3
  FFmpeg source: https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/commit/b08d7969c5
  Compiler line from ffmpeg -version: gcc 14.2.0 (Rev1, Built by MSYS2 project)
  External library version strings, including x264 v0.164.3192 (no commit id)
  and x265 4.0-6-ga009ec077 (short id only).
  https://www.gyan.dev/ffmpeg/builds/ (page v59, retrieved 2026-10-26) says
  the static builds are GPLv3 and links each current build to one FFmpeg
  commit. It does not publish the library sources or the build scripts.
  Queries are directed to builds at that domain.

What is still missing for this exact static binary
  - source archives for every library named in the README version list,
    at the commit or tarball actually compiled, including patches
  - a unique x264 commit; "v0.164.3192" is only a version string
  - source and package versions for libraries enabled in the configuration
    but absent from that version list: bzlib, fontconfig, gmp, gnutls,
    iconv, libxml2, lzma, zlib
  - nasm version
  - the exact MSYS2 package set behind gcc 14.2.0 Rev1
  - the media-autobuild_suite revision, ini, and per-library configure flags
    used on 2024-09-30
  - a build log showing those inputs produced this SHA256
  Current media-autobuild_suite master fetches current git checkouts. It is
  not a record of this build. A link to FFmpeg commit b08d7969c5 is not the
  corresponding source of the static executable.

No written offer was attached to the binary. None is made here.
GPLv3 section 6c is limited to occasional noncommercial copies.
